_comment: Example FieldMap for file/webhook ingestion of a generic desk RFQ export. Copy, edit the keys to match the provider's payload, and pass via --field-map. Transforms: ts_is_epoch/expiry_is_epoch/reference_ts_is_epoch set true when those fields are unix ms (or epoch seconds — auto-detected); fees_in_bps true when the fee field is in basis points. Side synonyms accepted: buy/bid/long, sell/ask/short. Status synonyms accepted: quoted/filled/answered, rejected/declined/canceled, expired, no_response/timeout.
